signature: SUBROUTINE DLAR1V( N, B1, BN, LAMBDA, D, L, LD, LLD,

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix L D $L^T$.

params.name: b1
params.reference: First index of the submatrix of L D $L^T$.

params.name: bn
params.reference: Last index of the submatrix of L D $L^T$.

params.name: lambda
params.reference: The shift. In order to compute an accurate eigenvector, `LAMBDA` should be a good approximation to an eigenvalue of L D $L^T$.

params.name: d
params.reference: The n diagonal elements of the diagonal matrix D.

params.name: l
params.reference: The (n-1) subdiagonal elements of the unit bidiagonal matrix L, in elements 1 to N-1.

params.name: LD
params.reference: The n-1 elements $L(i) \, D(i)$.

params.name: LLD
params.reference: The n-1 elements $L(i) \, L(i) \, D(i)$.

params.name: pivmin
params.reference: The minimum pivot in the Sturm sequence.

params.name: gaptol
params.reference: Tolerance that indicates when eigenvector entries are negligible w.r.t. their contribution to the residual.

params.name: z
params.reference: On input, all entries of Z must be set to 0. On output, Z contains the (scaled) r-th column of the inverse. The scaling is such that `Z(R)` equals 1.

params.name: wantnc
params.reference: Specifies whether `NEGCNT` has to be computed.

params.name: negcnt
params.reference: If `WANTNC` is .TRUE. then `NEGCNT` = the number of pivots \< pivmin in the matrix factorization L D $L^T$, and `NEGCNT = -1` otherwise.

params.name: ztz
params.reference: The square of the 2-norm of Z.

params.name: mingma
params.reference: The reciprocal of the largest (in magnitude) diagonal element of the inverse of L D $L^T - \sigma$ I.

params.name: r
params.reference: The twist index for the twisted factorization used to compute Z. On input, $0 \le R \le N$. If R is input as 0, R is set to the index where $(L D L^T - \sigma I)$^{-1} is largest in magnitude. If $1 \le R \le N$, R is unchanged. On output, R contains the twist index used to compute Z. Ideally, R designates the position of the maximum entry in the eigenvector.

params.name: ISUPPZ
params.reference: The support of the vector in Z, i.e., the vector Z is nonzero only in elements `ISUPPZ(1)` through ISUPPZ( 2 ).

params.name: nrminv
params.reference: $\mathrm{NRMINV} = 1/\sqrt{ \mathrm{ZTZ} }$

params.name: resid
params.reference: The residual of the FP vector. $\mathrm{RESID} = \lvert \mathrm{MINGMA} \rvert/\sqrt{ \mathrm{ZTZ} }$

params.name: rqcorr
params.reference: The Rayleigh Quotient correction to `LAMBDA`. $\mathrm{RQCORR} = \mathrm{MINGMA} \, \mathrm{TMP}$
